request: Verify DebugAI existing Docker container authenticates same four AI Core Gate model identities without exposing secrets.

bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; c=$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=debug-ai); test "$(printf '%s\n' "$c" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 31; docker exec "$c" node -e 'const ids={"18181":"/models/granite-4.2-8b-Q4_K_M.gguf","18182":"/models/Qwen3-8B-Q4_K_M.gguf","18183":"/models/Ministral-3-8B-Reasoning-2512-Q4_K_M.gguf","18184":"/models/qwen2.5-coder-7b-instruct-q4_k_m.gguf"};const k=process.env.AI_CORE_API_KEY;if(!k)process.exit(33);Promise.all(Object.entries(ids).map(async([p,id])=>{const r=await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:"+p+"/v1/models",{headers:{Authorization:"Bearer "+k},redirect:"error",signal:AbortSignal.timeout(5000)});const j=await r.json();if(r.status!==200||j.data?.length!==1||j.data[0].id!==id)throw Error("IDENTITY_"+p)})).then(()=>console.log("DEBUGAI_GATE_4_OF_4_OK")).catch(e=>{console.error(e.message);process.exit(34)})'
